audience: marketers who run campaign links and check their clicks in Linkly

useCases.title: Review the click totals of the short links
useCases.text: List the short links of a workspace with their click totals. Then read one link to see its destination and UTM parameters.

useCases.title: Compare where the clicks come from
useCases.text: Read the top values of one click dimension, such as country or referer. Then read the click series of chosen links.

useCases.title: Check the conversions and domains of a campaign
useCases.text: List the recorded conversions, newest first. Then list the custom domains that the links use.

useCases.title: Create a short link for a campaign URL
useCases.text: Create a short link for a destination URL in one workspace. Then read the link to check its settings.
